'''2001 Mystic Visions tournament (second event)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mystic Visions Gaming Convention, Columbia, PA on 5 May 2001. [[Drew Scott]] won it. It is known from Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2236">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-05-mystic-visions-columbia-pa-5-5-01d2236/ mystic-visions-columbia-pa-5-5-01], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 5 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-05-mystic-visions-columbia-pa-5-5-01d2236/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 5 May 2001
* '''Site:''' Mystic Visions Gaming Convention, Columbia, PA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Drew Scott]]
